summary: @servicetitan/measure-sheet-data 2.6.1 ships preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js via execFileSync. math_init.js is a ~728 KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` file containing a large packed numeric constant table, a string-array rotator (`WV8StW`), and mangled identifiers — heavily obfuscated code executed only under the fetched Bun runtime rather than the Node interpreter the rest of the ecosystem uses. The package presents itself as a React data library for glass measurement (main=dist/index.js, peerDependencies react>=17.0.2, description "Measurement data for glass for ServiceTitan") — a scope and purpose that has no need for an alternate language runtime or an opaque install-time bundle. Installing this version causes automatic download and execution of the obfuscated payload under Bun on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
